'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Greg Hodur DS Set Your Course For Home''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Hodur]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Set Your Course For Fred.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Home / The Ultimate Power]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
